text: Return all approved drugs with an indication for schizophrenia. For each drug, provide the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, EFO ID, indication label (EFO term), and the maximum phase for that indication. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures for SMILES, and to drug_indication on molregno. Filter where max_phase_for_ind is 4 and the mesh_heading equals 'Schizophrenia'.
